📊 Market & Chart

Harga live via Binance publik, 6 pair, timeframe 5m–1d. Candle chart + sinyal BUY / SELL / HOLD dari strategi EmaRsiCross (EMA-9/21 + RSI-14).

🧪 Backtest di HP

Uji strategi tanpa server: total profit, winrate, max drawdown, dan riwayat 10 trade terakhir. Port Kotlin dari SampleStrategy freqtrade.

🤖 Kontrol Bot VPS

Hubungkan ke api_server freqtrade: status, profit, balance, performance, start/stop, forceexit. Kosongkan URL untuk mode demo.

📲 Cara dapat APK

Opsi 1 — GitHub Actions: buka tab Actions → Build FreqDroid APK → unduh artifact FreqDroid-debug-apk → kirim ke HP → izinkan “Install unknown apps”.

Opsi 2 — Build sendiri:

./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
# hasil: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

Syarat: JDK 17 + Android SDK (compileSdk 34, minSdk 26 = Android 8+). Paket: com.freqdroid.app.debug.

🖥️ Hubungkan ke bot asli (opsional)

"api_server": {"enabled": true, "listen_ip_address": "0.0.0.0", "port": 8080}

Restart freqtrade trade --config config.json, lalu di aplikasi buka tab Server dan isi URL + username + password → Simpan & Hubungkan.

FreqDroid • companion paper-trading, bukan freqtrade penuh (tanpa FreqAI/Hyperopt) • Edukasi, bukan nasihat finansial. Mulai selalu dengan Dry-run.
